nodes.label: Debounce saveItemCode
nodes.rationale: BulkyApp.tsx debounces 400ms before dispatching saveItemCode to the store, to avoid dispatching (and persisting) on every keystroke.

nodes.label: Debounce syncAnalyzedCalls
nodes.rationale: BulkyApp.tsx debounces syncAnalyzedCalls by 300ms and skips it during a run or an item switch, to avoid re-analyzing the script on every keystroke or on the render that follows a store-driven code change.

nodes.label: Memoize item lookup
nodes.rationale: Replaced an O(n) collections.flatMap(...).find(...) scan with the existing selectActiveItem selector, avoiding a full re-scan of all collections on every lookup.

nodes.label: Stop spreading every call on every update
nodes.rationale: Unresolved: calls.map((c) => ({ ...c })) in scriptRunner.ts is still called per-update, copying every call object each time. Fixing it requires a larger architecture change (structural sharing or an immer-based store for calls), so it is deferred rather than patched superficially.

nodes.label: Debounce timeout input
nodes.rationale: The call-timeout input was moved to TweaksPanel with a 400ms debounce on local state, so typing a timeout value does not dispatch on every keystroke.

nodes.label: Extract auth header builder
nodes.rationale: buildAuthHeaders(opts, envVars) was extracted in scriptRunner.ts and is shared by makeCall and makeSseCall, removing duplicated auth-header logic between the two call paths.

nodes.label: Extract onRun to custom hook
nodes.rationale: src/hooks/useScriptRunner.ts now owns all run logic (run, next, stop, abort), pulling it out of the page/component layer for reuse and testability.

nodes.label: Fix eslint-disable suppressions
nodes.rationale: All 3 stale-dependency eslint-disable suppressions were removed from BulkyApp.tsx by fixing the underlying dependency arrays properly, rather than silencing the linter.

nodes.label: Fix error: any
nodes.rationale: proxy/route.ts now types the catch clause as unknown and narrows with instanceof Error, instead of the unsafe error: any pattern.

nodes.label: Replace opts as never casts
nodes.rationale: A proper CallOpts type was defined so makeCall/makeSseCall signatures use it, eliminating unsafe 'opts as never' casts that previously bypassed type checking.

nodes.label: Add error boundary
nodes.rationale: src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx now wraps the app in providers.tsx, so a render error in one subtree does not blank the whole app.

nodes.label: Prune viewByItemId
nodes.rationale: uiSlice.ts uses extraReducers to delete the viewByItemId entry when an item is removed, preventing unbounded growth of per-item UI state as items are deleted.

nodes.label: Prune callsByItemId
nodes.rationale: runnerSlice.ts uses extraReducers to delete the callsByItemId entry on removeItem, mirroring the viewByItemId prune to avoid unbounded memory growth.

nodes.label: Cap persisted response size
nodes.rationale: persist.ts trims strings over 50KB and objects whose JSON exceeds 50KB before writing to localforage, to keep the persisted payload bounded.

nodes.label: SSRF risk in proxy — accepted
nodes.rationale: Accepted risk for a local dev tool: the proxy is intentionally used to call local/private APIs, so blocking private IPs would break its primary use case. Recommendation is to deploy behind auth if exposing it publicly, rather than blocking SSRF outright.

nodes.label: Add proxy timeout
nodes.rationale: proxy/route.ts aborts the upstream fetch after 30s via AbortController and returns a 'Proxy timeout' error, so a hanging upstream call cannot hang the proxy indefinitely.

nodes.label: Keyboard shortcut for Run
nodes.rationale: Already implemented: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter is wired in MonacoCodeEditor.tsx to run the script without leaving the editor.

nodes.label: Abort running script
nodes.rationale: useScriptRunner creates an AbortController per run; onStop propagates the abort signal through runScript, and a Stop button was added to the CodeEditor toolbar so a user can cancel an in-flight run.

nodes.label: Console height toggle
nodes.rationale: The console panel in ResponsePanel gained an expand/collapse toggle (90px collapsed to 240px expanded) so it does not permanently crowd the response view.

nodes.label: Move timeout config to TweaksPanel
nodes.rationale: Timeout configuration was removed from the ResponsePanel header and moved into TweaksPanel with a debounced local input and a clear button, consolidating run-affecting settings into one place.

nodes.label: Migrate inline styles to Tailwind
nodes.rationale: Deferred: entire-app scope, high churn risk, no functional benefit — not worth the risk for a purely cosmetic refactor.

nodes.label: Type ResizablePanel sizes consistently
nodes.rationale: Deferred: needs a react-resizable-panels v4 API audit before the size prop types can be made consistent.
